# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-session-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, '-' for none.
rule 5000 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5000"; flow:established;)
rule 5001 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5001"; flow:not_established;)
rule 5002 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5002"; flow:to_server;)
rule 5003 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5003"; flow:to_client;)

rule 5010 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5010"; flow.pkts:either,>=4;)
rule 5011 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5011"; flow.bytes:toserver,>10;)
rule 5012 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5012"; flow.bytes:toclient,>0;)
rule 5013 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5013"; flow.bytes:either,<41;)
rule 5014 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5014"; flow.age:0;)
rule 5015 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"session 5015"; flow.age:>=2;)
